name: agy

argv: Read the task in {prompt_file} and carry it out. End with your final answer.

notes: Print mode takes the prompt as an argument, so the harness writes it to a file and passes the path. Upstream reports print mode hanging or dropping stdout without a TTY (google-antigravity/antigravity-cli issues 76 and 318) and the service is not available in every region; verify with doctor --deep before relying on it. The provider timeout ends a hung run.
